title: Trying to save her parents money by choosing the smallest library books
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: Some interesting responses about the suggested no confidence motion on Ed Vaizey at the forthcoming CILIP AGM, reported on yesterday. None of them actually defend the man. If you’re a CILIP member and are interested, email noconfidenceinvaizey@gmail.com for more information. I look forward to hearing Michael Rosen on the future of public libraries in a two-part Radio Four programme in August and September. He’s a keen advocate for libraries, comes up with great ideas (see his passion for automatic library cards for schoolchildren for example) and, as a non-librarian, can see things from the outside.
